mapper.select: select a.* From b_xiecheng_colliding_data_rob_task a join b_xiecheng_colliding_data_package b on a.package_id = b.id and b.is_delete =0 where date(a.start_time) = date(now()) and a.task_status = 0 and a.is_delete =0 and now() > a.start_time order by a.start_time ,b.priority asc limit 1;
mapper.update: update b_xiecheng_colliding_data_rob_task set task_status = 1 where id =#{id}
